title: Visit Restoration Charge on Reinstating a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
**Fee schedule — restoration of expired visits, Self-Pay Visit Package.** The restoration charge depends on how many visits the expiry removed: where **5** or more visits are restored, **$4.00** is charged for every visit restored; where between one and fewer than 5 visits are restored, a single **$5.00** is charged; where no visit is restored, nothing is charged. The restoration charge is added to the reinstatement charge.

**Visits restored.** The visits removed at the package's expiry, as the latest expiry entry in the package history records them.

| Visits restored | Restoration charge |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 to 4 | $5.00, once |
| 5 or more | $4.00 for each visit restored |

**Worked charges (hypothetical)**

| Visits restored | Charge |
|---|---|
| 1 | $5.00 |
| 4 | $5.00 |
| 5 | 5 visits at $4.00: $20.00 |
| 8 | 8 visits at $4.00: $32.00 |
| 12 | 12 visits at $4.00: $48.00 |
